item.name: List all policy amendment intents for a policy

request.name: List all policy amendment intents for a policy

description.content: Returns a paginated list of policy amendment intents for the specified policy. The intents are returned sorted by creation date, with the oldest intent appearing first.

query.description: Multiple values can be provided by separating them with a comma. Allowed values are: `action_required`, `awaiting_quote`, `pending_confirmation`, `processing`, `amended`, `processing_error`, `not_undertaken`.
The page of results to return. Defaults to 1 if not provided.
The number of results to return per page. Defaults to 10 if not provided. Maximum value is 100.

response.name: OK

item.name: Create a dependents management intent for a policy amendment

request.name: Create a dependents management intent for a policy amendment

description.content: Creates a dependents management intent as a sub-intent of a policy amendment intent. The sub-intent allows the platform to add or remove dependents from the policy. The policy amendment intent must be in `action_required` status with a `dependents` requested change.
